items.source: Register an individual bean with the MBeanServer.
items.translation: 使用 `MBeanServer` 注册单个 Bean。

items.source: Register the supplied resource with JMX.
items.translation: 将提供的资源注册到 JMX。

items.source: Uses of MBeanExportException in org.springframework.jmx.export

This package provides declarative creation and registration of
Spring-managed beans as JMX MBeans.
items.translation: 该包提供对 Spring 管理的 Bean 作为 JMX MBean 进行声明式创建和注册。

items.source:
Exception thrown when we are unable to register an MBean,
for example because of a naming conflict.
items.translation: 无法注册 MBean 时抛出异常，例如由于命名冲突。

items.source:
Creates an MBean that is configured with the appropriate management
interface for the supplied managed resource.
items.translation: 创建具有为提供的受管资源配置的适当管理接口的 MBean。
